description: Ministry of Power, Energy & Business Development - Order to acquire the land in Weliwa, Pitabeddara D/S Division, Matara District for the Ceylon Electricity Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains an order under the Ceylon Electricity Board Act approving the acquisition of specific lands described in detail, including location, boundaries, and extent. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content focuses entirely on land/property matters (acquisition of lands for electricity board purposes), making Land Gazette (Type 4) the appropriate classification rather than a government personnel type.
